subject: Disability Resource Fair Planning
overview: The commission met to plan logistics, vendors, and promotional materials for an upcoming Disability Resource Fair and pride event. Members also voted to invite the Medford Public Schools ADA committee to their next meeting and approved sending letters advocating for accessibility improvements at the West Medford commuter rail station.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes for January and February.

items.title: Disability Resource Fair Planning
items.summary: Commissioners discussed logistics for the April 29 event, debating venues such as Medford High School versus the Andrews and Brooks schools, coordinating vendor outreach, and reviewing promotional items and budget constraints.

items.title: Public Library Accessibility and Technology Resources
items.summary: Members heard a report on Medford Public Library accessibility services, including homebound delivery, sensory quiet spaces, assistive technology, and upcoming tech support sessions hosted by students.

items.title: Remembrances of Judy Heumann and Civil Rights Reflections
items.summary: Commissioners reflected on historical parallels to the 1960s civil rights movement and shared personal memories honoring disability rights activist Judy Heumann following her passing.

items.title: Invitation to Medford Public Schools ADA Committee
items.summary: The commission voted to take from the table and approve a motion inviting the Medford Public Schools ADA committee to attend their next meeting.

items.title: West Medford Commuter Rail Station Accessibility Support
items.summary: The commission voted to draft and resend letters to the governor, lieutenant governor, mayor, and city council supporting funding to make the West Medford commuter rail station accessible.
